changelog: Smarter home rows driven by what you actually watch, not the raw download schedule. 'New Since You Were Away' now shows only genuine events - a movie that became available, or a series whose episode aired or downloaded while you were gone - and never mislabels an old unwatched season as new. New 'Continue the Story' row surfaces shows you started but didn't finish: seasons you skipped and series you abandoned (kept separate from Continue Watching, so a show appears in just one card). Coming Soon is now personalized: your monitored series lead with their next episode, new seasons of shows you've watched are highlighted, and the rest is filtered to high-quality, taste-matched upcoming titles instead of the whole calendar. No new database tables; the home degrades gracefully if Sonarr/Radarr is unreachable.
